verdict.rationale: Calendly's own Workflows feature is documented to automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts to invitees, hosts, and teammates. That covers reminders and follow-ups over both email and SMS around bookings, and the homepage adds that follow-ups are handled. The evidence is a single marketing-level statement, with no detail on configuring sequence timing or multiple steps. missing for 10: detailed docs on sequence configuration (timing offsets, multi-step sequences, per-event-type triggers), evidence of no-show reduction, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a sales lead, automated reminder and follow-up sequences (email/SMS) fire around every booking to cut no-shows

citations.quote: Use Workflows to automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts to invitees, hosts, and teammates.
Finish the day knowing every meeting was captured, next steps were tracked, and follow-ups were handled.
